items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Joy Wynn had left, had left. And that's why we hired, I forgot to see how you get tangled up, is that all right? Yeah, that's okay, don't worry. No, look, Joy Wynn left us, he got into some kind of finance trouble with Mr. Earl and Dr. Grundy, and he skipped out of town

ctx.x: I don't know whether he might be Eagle Eye Shields, but he was the leader of that band. Edmund Hall played with Eagle Eye Shields. Well, I'm going to get to that, Edmund Hall was at, now I ain't going to Jacksonville, but the band was consistent of, like I told you, I go back to Joy Morris on trombone, the band on trumpet, Edmund Washington on sax and clandered, Edmund Hall on sax and clandered, Albert Morgan on bass. Oh, I forgot to tell you how I went, Joy Wynn, Joy Wynn had left, had left. And that's why we…
Did you ever hear Alonzo Ross? Alonzo Ross. Alonzo Ross, he was a piano player I think over there. From where? Around Jacksonville, I think.
